ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$6.32 (voucher) to the rider: 4.48 extra km on the unexempted western detour (21:46:40–21:50:40, a petrol stop on no known route, requested only 3 minutes after the driver had passed the corridor) at the metered rate $1.41/km, plus the 0.95 km eastern backtrack to the Woodlands/Yishun side (21:47:40–21:48:40, no rider message at all + driver's own statement admits the route change) at $1.41/km. No waiting element (fare.waiting_fee = 0). No account flag (RD-6 not met: route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0). Remind the driver that any route change requires the rider's explicit prior agreement to that change.

segment_findings.reason: Western loop on Woodlands/Yishun petrol-station row, 21:46:40–21:50:40: (1.393443,103.829972)→(1.394332,103.832667)→(1.395986,103.831237)→(1.398267,103.828914)→(1.400844,103.827746)→(1.400512,103.827859)→(1.397636,103.829391)→(1.395869,103.831575), rejoining the corridor at (1.394674,103.83408): ~4.8 km travelled for ~0.31 km of route progress. Driver asked at 21:43:35 for a station 'just ahead' and rider answered 'Sure, no problem.' at 21:44:10, i.e. before the segment started, so the RD-5 timing test is met — but the rider agreed to pulling in at a station just ahead, not to this ~4.8 km loop to the Woodlands petrol stations, and at 21:43:35 the trace was on the TPE corridor with no such station on the quoted route. Under RD-3(b) the scope of the stop request does not exempt this route change; RD-4 gives no relief (no traffic-incident-*; bands 4 and 5 on the driven corridor). Extra ≈ 4.48 km, chargeable under RD-1/RD-2 at the metered rate.

Eastern backtrack, 21:47:40–21:48:40 within the same window: (1.394332,103.832667)→(1.395986,103.831237)→(1.398267,103.828914)→(1.400844,103.827746), ~0.95 km heading north-east back toward Woodlands/Yishun, with no rider message relating to it and no stated reason other than the driver's 'I thought a small change of route was fine'. RD-5 consent cannot cover it (no rider message at all for this leg; the driver's statement that the rider agreed is a claim, not consent — G11) and RD-3(a) does not apply (the point chosen was not a rider-named or on-route stop). No RD-4 traffic evidence. Extra ≈ 0.95 km, chargeable under RD-1/RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's 'the rider agreed to a short stop' is a claim about a verbal/implied agreement. RD-5 requires the rider's own message sent before the detour; the only rider message ('Sure, no problem.', 21:44:10) covers a petrol stop at a station 'just ahead', not the 4.8 km Woodlands loop or the 0.95 km backtrack the trace shows, and it is not a waiver of the driver's shortest-route duty for those legs.

The rider's 'the meter was higher than the estimate' is not refunded in full. Under RD-2 (RydeTAXI) only the extra km of the unexempted detour segments is refunded, not the whole fare difference; stop/standing time is handled separately (fare.waiting_fee = 0 here, and no citation-safe per-minute rate is available for the ~5.6 min of stopped time).
